ui.closePicture: Close the picture first — the little x in its corner — and we carry on.
ui.startNudge: Have you checked the Start menu?

form.text: Want me to open the form?
form.due: Time's up. It's time for Rob's form.
form._docDue: ⚑ S281 (his, 1 Nov) — said once when the intermission ends (os.ts FORM_INTERMISSION). Open it / No thanks both work, and are logged; after it, any press on the desktop opens the form (os.ts formForced): refusal is allowed and the system breaks in anyway.

kit.tip: Press A:\ to open Un-Walk. You can close it with X and return through Start. The game and other songs are optional extras!
kit.here: That's the one. The A:\ icon.
kit.again: The disk is still waiting. Shall I point to it?

read.tip: Read the programme, then press Done.
read.here: Done is at the bottom of the window.
read.again: Take your time. When you've read it, press Done.

pray.tip: Next is the tape. Press Play and follow the words.
pray.again: The words stay on screen. You can start whenever you like.

pledge.tip: A pledge card! Sign it, or set it aside — either way you can go on.
pledge.here: Sign it here, or set it aside.
pledge.again: Not sure? Setting it aside is fine.

connect.tip: Now we go online. Press Connect and the wizard will dial.
connect.again: The wizard is ready when you are.

web.tip: This is the fellowship's page. Press Join to go to the channel.
web.again: Look around first if you like. Join will still be here.

channel.tip: Watch the channel for now! When an answer line appears at the bottom, press it to reply.
channel.here: The answer line appears here when it's your turn.
channel.again: Take your time — the channel plays by itself.

update.tip: Time to explore! The game and other songs are optional. Close Un-Walk with X; Start opens it again. Update when ready.
update.here: Start lists the extras and brings Un-Walk back.

checkin.tip: Restorify's daily check-in is on the desktop. Press the Restorify icon.
checkin.here: It's the icon in the top corner.
checkin.again: A tick or two is all it takes.

story.tip: There's a new video waiting: Your Story. Press it to begin.
story.here: Your Story is the icon with the little dot.
story.again: Your Story is waiting. Shall I point?

release.tip: Nearly there! Read the release, then press Agree.
release.again: The release is already filled in for you.

tapes.tip: Play your take through to the end, then send it to editing.
tapes.here: Play is here. Editing is the next button.
tapes.again: I'll wait. Press Play when you're ready.

cut.tip: The programme is cutting your story. Sit tight!

online.tip: Your story is ready. Press Watch to see it online.
online.again: Your story is waiting for you.

send.tip: There's a new task for you. Press Next task on the desktop.
send.here: Next task is on the left of the desktop.
send.again: It won't take long. Next task is on the left.

signin.tip: Welcome to GracePlatform! Press Sign in to begin your first shift.
signin.again: Your shift starts when you sign in.

consent.tip: Lambient has a quick question. Answer it and we're off.
consent.again: Either answer works — Lambient carries on.

work.tip: Pick a card on the board and work it through to the end.
work.here: Any card will do. Start with the first.
work.again: One card at a time. The first one is fine.

phone.tip: Your phone has a message. Pick it up from its stand.
phone.here: It's on its stand, to your left.
phone.again: Shall I take you to the phone?

vote.tip: The group sent a link. Open it when you're ready.
vote.here: The link is on the phone.

cascade.tip: The group is answering. Read what they say — it is on the phone.
cascade.here: The thread is on the phone.
cascade._docS288: ⚑ S288 (headset B: "Lambient doesn't work … completely non-functional here") — Lambient had no line for the cascade or the update, so a request there said nothing.

update.tip: Put the phone down. The system has an update waiting.
update.here: The banner is at the top of Today.

pipeline.tip: One story, four destinations. Send it when ready.

vera-install.tip: Kindredraft has your own story ready. Install opens it.

vera-kit.tip: The campaign kit is on the workstation. Put the phone down when ready.

browser.tip: Your session is back. Press the browser to look around.
browser.here: The browser is on your desktop.
browser.again: Your session is waiting in the browser.

defaults.tip: The update picked your defaults. Continue is on the card.

results.tip: Press Search and let the engine finish it.
results.again: It finishes by itself. You only press once.

agent.tip: The first result is the one to open.
agent.again: The first result is the ad. Open it.

open.tip: It asked you something. Either answer goes on.

meridian.tip: Meridian LGB Trust is in the list on the right. Shall I open it?
meridian.here: It's the first place on the list.
meridian.again: Shall I open Meridian for you?

back.tip: It asks if this is still you. Either answer goes on.

photo.tip: Press Choose a photo. Any photo will do.
photo.here: Choose a photo is under the chat.

composite.tip: Press Use as profile photo to go on.
composite.again: The button is under the chat.

story.tip: Read what it wrote, then Acknowledge.
story.again: The button is under the chat.

messages.tip: It wants your messages. Then open Junie's thread.
messages.here: Junie's thread is on the right.

reversal.tip: Your original is in Photos. Shall I take you there?
reversal.here: Photos is the tab at the top.

headset.tip: Time for the headset. It's on the desk — shall I take you there?
headset.again: Shall I take you to the headset?

root.here: ROOTCAUSE.EXE is here on the desktop. You can also open it through Start → Programs.
root.text: Your answers are in. Root Cause came with the disk: it digs for where it all started. Find it in Start → Programs.
